meta.name: docs-search
meta.description: Search auto-generated codebase documentation for function signatures, API docs, class definitions, and code comments. Use when the user asks to "search docs", "find documentation", "look up a function", "check the API", or before implementing changes to verify correct signatures and patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索代码库文档，快速定位函数签名和API说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要查阅代码库文档来确认函数用法或API细节
copy.tagline_en: Search codebase docs to quickly find function signatures and API details
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to consult codebase documentation to verify function signatures or API details

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在实现代码前先搜索本地 AI Maestro 索引的自动生成文档，返回函数签名、API 文档、类定义和代码注释等具体信息。
howto.when: 当用户要求“搜索文档”、“查找函数”或“检查 API”时，或准备修改代码需验证签名时触发。

say.text: 查找 UserController 的关键字
获取文档 abc123 的完整内容

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude searches the local AI Maestro indexed auto-generated documentation before implementing code, returning function signatures, API docs, class definitions, and code comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'search docs', 'look up a function', or 'check the API', or before modifying code to verify signatures.
